Take out their shields!|audio = FrostWave28-1.ogg|[[Commander]] on Wave 28 ([[Frost Mode|Frost]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Frost Ravager''' is a strong and fast enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It has a high amount of health and initially an average speed. However, three seconds after spawning in, it will speed up, close to doubling its speed and it will keep that speed until it runs out of its [[Shield Health]]. As it has multiple immunities, it will be harder to slow down while running through the map. ==Logbook Description== "''Guardians of the Frost Realm and Frost Spirit, Frost Ravagers are deadly foes transformed into the most fearsome defensive entities. Carrying the light of the Frost Spirit, they wield thick, heavy shields made of Umbrite. As their shields are depleted, Frost Ravagers speed up toward their targets.''" ==Appearance== The '''Frost Ravager''' is an entity with a white body. Its arms are covered with ice armor, which also has spikes on it. On its torso, it has three neon blue crystals and it wears a belt with blue padding. On its head, it has a small blue mask with two eye holes, revealing its two, neon blue eyes. It wields a grey heavy shield made out of Umbrite which has chains wrapped around it. ==Strategy== *The '''Frost Ravager''' is quite dangerous due to its high health, especially when using ''Leading Dash'', which can make it move at a much faster speed. *High range and DPS towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] are great against the '''Frost Ravager.''' **The [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] are especially useful, as their high range allows them to keep it in range for longer. *As it has quite high defense, defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful against it. **As it has the [[Freeze Immunity]], freeze cannot be used to drop its defense until it has lost its [[Shield Health]]. *You cannot use knockback towers like the [[Brawler]], because of its [[Stun Immunity]]. **Stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] can still be used, though they will only slow it down instead of stunning it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} FrostRavagerFront.png|First version, second animation, front view (17 December 2024 – 20 December 2024) FrostRavagerSide.png|First version, second animation, side view (17 December 2024 – 20 December 2024) RavanagerNew.png|Second version, front view (16 December 2024 – 17 December 2024, 20 December 2024 – 3 December 2025) FrostRavangerSideView.png|Second version, side view (16 December 2024 – 17 December 2024, 20 December 2024 – 3 December 2025) FrostRavagerNoAnim.png|Third version, no animation (3 December 2025 - If the [[Shield Health]] is depleted before it gets to start dashing, this animation will become permanent. **As a result of this, its death animation will now have it fall over with its shield to the side, something normally not possible to see. *The Umbrite material mentioned in the '''Frost Ravager's''' logbook description may have been named after [[The Umbra]]. *The '''Frost Ravager''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Frost Ravager''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Frost Ravager''' cannot have its defense dropped by the [[Jester]]. **{{Bug}} It is possible to stunlock the '''Frost Ravager''' by constantly stunning it during its animation before it gains the speed boost.
